title: Perfect size for microwave popcorn
text: Perfect size for microwave popcorn. I bought these bags for microwave popcorn. They are larger than regular lunch bags. They have split on me a few times so not the best quality but I’ll use up what I’ve bought & continues to find something heavier

features: Use these paper bags to pack sandwiches, food orders or retail purchases.

Paper grocery bags and lunch bags are commonly stamped with the name of the manufacturer, The size of the bag, and information required for recycling. However, the majority of the bag's surface is plain.
description: These extra-large and extra-heavy bags are ideal for everything, made from sturdy kraft paper. Each package comes with 40 bags. Use these paper bags to pack sandwiches, food orders or retail purchases.
